translations.web: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
translations.bsb: A wise man fears and turns from evil, but a fool is careless and reckless.
translations.kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
translations.asv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil; But the fool beareth himself insolently, and is confident.
